### A Light in the Darkness
Author: Amy Carroll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/a-light-in-the-darkness-encouragement-for-today-apr-24-2013.html
Passage: Exodus 27:21
Points:
- The Tabernacle lampstand and its continuous burning flame illustrate God's design for believers.
- Believers serve as earthly tents bearing the light of Christ, powered by the Holy Spirit.
- Christians need constant spiritual refueling through prayer, abiding in Christ, and studying Scripture.
- God calls His followers to move courageously into dark places so His light can guide others.
